newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Manuli Rubber share offer price set.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Manuli Rubber share offer price set.

text.p: The board of Italy's Manuli Rubber Industries said it fixed its public sale offer price at 5,650 lire per share.

Manuli's market placement, to start on Monday ahead of a bourse listing, is of 26 million ordinary shares equal to 28.2 percent of its capital, with 18.2 million shares earmarked for Italian and foreign institutional investors and the rest on public offer.
Sources close to the rubber tubing multinational company said that book building had ended on Thursday with great success, with demand for shares around eight times that of the offer.
